programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn't give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow's nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown's face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS - ROOKIE THE DJ

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.
programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.desc: When a couple can't decide on a wedding theme, they hire two wedding planners, Taylor and Ben, to compete for the job by proposing two very different styles.

programme.title: You May Kiss The Bridesmaid
programme.desc: Scarlett Bailey is presented with the opportunity of a lifetime to work as a pastry chef in one of NYC's top restaurants. Her life gets put on hold when she returns to her hometown for her sister Maddie's wedding.

programme.title: How to Find Forever
programme.desc: Marley is great at organizing other people's engagements but unlucky with love. However, the man who could jeopardize her latest project may also be Mr. Right.

programme.title: A Missed Connection
programme.desc: After finding a spark with a woman on a train platform, a photographer posts a missed connection in the newspaper, but never hears from her. Five years later, they're seated next to each other on a plane heading to the same wedding - hers.

programme.title: Troublesome
programme.desc: Veteran homicide detective Michael reluctantly partners with rookie Derrick. Witnessing a double homicide, they survive a deadly chase, but Derrick is wounded. The suspects are linked to the kingpin, who retaliates by ordering murders across the city. As chaos erupts, the FBI joins the case, revealing the kingpin's identity. Michael finds a weak link, offering a chance to finally catch him.

programme.title: Dirty Deception
programme.desc: Marcus is caught up by lust, drugs, murder and deception and must face the hardest challenge of his life. When he meets Charmaine, he has to make a major change in his life and become a better man. In his pursuit to become a better man, he finds the dirtiest deception of all may come at a cost that he can't afford.

programme.title: Road Rage
programme.desc: Dr. Stephen Blake is a brilliant physician with a traumatic and hard upbringing. On the edge of a breakdown, he embarks on a journey to discover the truth about what happened to his parents before their tragic death, causing his quest for truth to turn into vengeance. That is until he meets Jennifer, a nurse who shares his struggle, and helps carry the burden.

programme.title: SistAhood 2: Calling All Lovers
programme.desc: Jordyn Dixon and her group of girlfriends are working to better themselves and each other; however, secrets from the past and grudges in the present will test the future of their sisterhood circle.

programme.title: Trapped in the Game
programme.desc: Polo is a young desperate hustler looking to make some quick cash. However, the only way he knows how to make cash quickly, is pimping out young women with the help of his crew. When of his crew starts taking girls off the street, the heat threatens to bring down his whole operation.

programme.title: The Housekeeper 2
programme.desc: After moving on from her sordid past, Sharease flourishes in her new life and success. When her son Adonis is kidnapped, she seeks help from a ghost of her past to rescue him.

programme.title: Cooperating Criminals
programme.desc: Tony's ambition ignites a powder keg of betrayal. Driven by Bianca's manipulation, he pushes his pill operation, ignoring Jay's warnings. As DEA Agent Harrison closes in, Jay battles his past to protect Tony. A dangerous deal with Marco, escalates the chaos, leading to overdose and murder plots. Now, Tony faces a stark choice: witness or prison.

programme.title: Rage: Kill or Be Killed
programme.desc: Jackie "Labrae" Robinson dominates Houston's unsanctioned boxing circuit-until he comes face-to-face with the one opponent, he never imagined fighting: his personal hero, legendary champion Theo Barnes. However, Theo is a haunted man dealing with his own demons and an advanced case of CTE. A first meeting quickly escalates into an all-out brawl, making the stakes of two champion fighters that much higher.

programme.title: Taking What's Mine
programme.desc: Jordan Hayes, a decorated Army veteran turned rising political icon is thrown into a harrowing disaster when her journalist husband, Ethan, is captured by a rising terrorist leader, Khalid Rami. Rami will only release Ethan if Jordan helps overturn a new counter terrorism bill. Refusing to fight the red tape and bow to pressure, Jordan takes matters into her own hands and sets out to rescue him herself.

programme.title: The Bahama Hustle
programme.desc: Two up-n-coming rappers Ace and Cool breeze dream of becoming the next big thing in the rap world. After making a deal with Slick and Red, two promoters who promise wealth and success, they take out a loan from a local loan shark, Daddy T. To secure the loan Daddy T requires them to sign over body part as collateral. Their worlds crash when they discover that the two crooked rap promoters have ripped them off.

programme.title: Designer
programme.desc: Dre has aspirations of making it big in the cannabis industry, but when his perceived star plant dies, his hopes and dreams start to fade. He and his friends embark on a journey to become lords of the cannabis industry.

programme.title: A Wolf's Cries
programme.desc: Janice is a compulsive liar. In her new friend group, she causes chaos, breaking up couples and getting friends arrested. Believing she deserves everything; it's her way or the highway. Until someone sees her manipulation and aims to expose her.

programme.title: A Chosen Hope
programme.desc: After escaping her abusive husband, Talia has forged a new life for her and her daughter, Hope. When Hope begins experiencing mental illness and troubling visions, Talia learns her husband was part of a sinister cult, and Hope is marked as "The Chosen Soul". Talia must race against time to save her daughter before it's too late.

programme.title: Anatomy of Love
programme.desc: Cassious is a hopelessly romantic college student seeking to find love and companionship with his best friend Jenesis. However, Jenesis is an emotionally scarred college girl who has outspokenly lost her faith in true love. Coincidently, she is now challenged by her professor to document the opinions of at least 10 of her peers on the question "What is love?" Through the class assignment she examines her own values and finds the love she has been looking for might be right under her nose.

programme.title: The Morning After
programme.desc: After Michael & Tiffany end their five-year relationship, they awaken to find they've switched bodies. Now they are forced to work together to live each other's lives, while doing all they can to make sure friends and coworkers don't suspect a thing.

programme.title: The Love We Had
programme.desc: One decision results in a tragedy that threatens to rip a young couple apart at the seams while essentially destroying everything and everyone who means the most to them.

programme.title: Fair Play
programme.desc: Sisters, Freedom and Sasha, learn that when it comes to love, everything has a price...that's just FAIR PLAY.

programme.title: Finding Boaz
programme.desc: Church administrator, Torrey, attempts to put the pieces of her life together after a failed engagement. With fears of becoming a lonely cat lady, Torrey solicits the help of her worldly cousin Nell who puts Torrey in a How to Catch a Man School. Class includes, makeovers, shopping sprees, club hopping and tactics of deceit to help Torrey find the man of her dreams. Within the twists and turns of How to Catch a Man School, Torrey catches far more than she bargained for!

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: All I See Is You [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Gina is a beautiful young woman who's still haunted by the accident that took her sight years earlier. Living in Bangkok with her husband, James, she undergoes a cutting-edge operation that restores the vision to her right eye. Now that Gina can see again, she slowly starts to realize that her newfound independence makes James feel jealous, threatened and insecure.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Direct Contact
programme.desc: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given a chance at freedom if he can rescue a kidnapped woman.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: Animal Factory [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Before I Go To Sleep [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Ever since a vicious attack nearly claimed her life, Christine Lucas (Nicole Kidman) has suffered from anterograde amnesia and is unable to form new memories. Every morning, she becomes reacquainted with her husband, Ben (Colin Firth), and the other constants in her life. In accordance with her doctor's (Mark Strong) instructions, Christine keeps a video diary. As Christine starts to uncover terrifying truths about her past, she begins to question everything -- and everyone -- around her.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: Shortly before the outbreak of the Second World War, the Polish and British have succeeded in de-coding the top secret German military codes known as 'Enigma.' This information, referred to as 'Ultra' by the Allies, becomes vital for the Allies' military situation in North Africa, the Soviet Union, and Northern France.

programme.title: Vichy and the Nazis: A Deal with the Devil
programme.desc: 1942: Almost 80,000 French Jews are arrested, following the orders of Adolf Hitler and Vichy. From the Vel' d'Hiv Roundup to Auschwitz, thanks to the most recent historiography and reenactment, plunge into the making of the Holocaust.

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: The history of armed conflict is intrinsically tied to the history of civilization and Man's quest for the basic things in life. Over the centuries those weapons ranged from bow and arrows to armor, swords and chain mail. But one technological development left them all behind - the invention of gunpowder. Since then, the advances in weaponry have been both awe-inspiring, and frightening.

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: Another basic building block of civilization and warfare is the ship. From the Second Millennia BC, ships were used to transport troops to battle. The Egyptians and Syrians crossed the sea to do battle, and when they weren't fighting each other, they would use their vessels for trade, exploration and probably a little piracy! From the 7th and 6th centuries B.C, formal navies appeared.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific looks at U.S. and British interests in the Pacific prior to World War II including Alaska, Hawaii, Guam, Australia, and New Zealand. It also looks at developments in Siam, China, and Japan focusing on the growth of modernization and militarism in Japan prior to the war.

programme.title: War in the Pacific
programme.desc: Japanese bombing of Pearl Harbor brings America to war.
programme.sub-title: America Goes to War in the Pacific

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Speeding behind German lines the men of Troop A, in their armored cars and half-tracks left destruction and fear in their wake. Surprising the German garrison at the town of Epernay, they established an outpost from which they could defend a counter-attack. Outnumbered and outgunned with thirteen rounds of ammunition left, these brave GI's held this vital town until re-enforcements could arrive.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: Russia In Afghanistan
programme.desc: In 1979, the Soviets had ill-suited uniforms and inferior fighting tactics, and found it impossible to defeat the popular Afghan guerrilla army. They had underestimated their enemy and lacked the forces to win.

programme.title: Architects of Darkness
programme.desc: A journey into his world. The film explores the roots of Adolf Hitler and traces the story of his life from the town of his birth to his final days in a Berlin bunker.

programme.title: My Grandparents' War
programme.desc: Kristin Scott Thomas's grandfather William served as a Commanding officer in the Royal Navy throughout WW2. He survived some of the most devastating battles from Dunkirk to D-Day but never spoke about his experiences. For the first time, Kristin uncovers how he saved thousands at Dunkirk and endured the horrors of the Russian Artic convoys. Kristin's journey is packed with revelation and emotion.

programme.title: Hitler's Propaganda Machine
programme.desc: As Hitler's ambitions spread beyond Germany, the world drew toward another great war - to be fought on many battlefields, and for the hearts and minds of the people.

programme.title: The Attackers
programme.desc: Amidst WWII's war-torn skies, Soviet Major Bestuzhev defends the airdrome. A bond forms with comrade Zhenya, but facing overwhelming odds, they must protect their homeland, confronting fears in a narrative of sacrifice, courage, and camaraderie. As the air raid sirens wail, they delve deeper into the turmoil of war, discovering the true essence of duty and the resilience of the human spirit.

programme.title: Helicopter Warfare
programme.desc: In the Iraq War, flying in the desert poses unique difficulties - the dust storm that accompanies every landing and take-off - and the lack of places to hide. When a young Royal Navy pilot comes under fire from a tank, he soon finds himself engaged in a deadly game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: The Dawns Here are Quiet (English Version)
programme.desc: It is late spring of 1942, and World War 2 is in full swing. A long way off from the front-line the Germans make an air landing operation in an attempt to get through to the Kirov railway and the White Sea - Baltic Sea Canal. The only obstacle in their way is an anti-aircraft artillery unit of corporal Vaskov and five young women in training.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: After success in North Africa the Allies returned to occupied Europe, first landing on Sicily before moving north into Italy under command of Montgomery, known fondly by his men as Monty. But as the Italians surrendered, the Germans occupied Rome.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Invasion of Southern France by the 7th army and subsequent junction with the American 3rd army in northwest part of France.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: The processing of plasma and penicillin. Troops in Normandy receive medical care. Naval guns bombard Cherbourg. The 8th and 9th Air Forces bomb communication lines. British troops take Caen. Shows Gen. Montgomery.
programme.sub-title: First Aid and the Taking of Cherbourg

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: British artillery pounds German positions in northern France and troops advance through villages and care for civilians. Tanks clear mine fields. Part 2, American troops enter Cherbourg. The 6th Airborne Div. receives supplies by parachute from British planes. Gen. J.L. Collins accepts the surrender of German officers.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: 'Independence Day in Europe - In France, Eisenhower observes General Bradley fire a giant howitzer signaling our artillery into a massed crescendo of fire. Following the landing battles in Normandy, the Canadians return to the thick of the fighting at Cariquet. So severe that some Canadian camera crew were killed. In their sector, the Yanks are blazing through the hedge rows with grenade guns.

programme.title: Great Battles of The Civil War: Volume 1
programme.desc: Volume 1 - 1861-1863. This in depth volume combines archival material with faithfully created battle re-enactments to depict the real horror and heroism of the American Civil War combat from 1861-1863. Witness the sacrifice of over 600,000 patriots in fierce hand-to-hand combat and face-to-face warfare struggling to preserve their ways of life.

programme.title: The US Battle For Supremacy In The Pacific
programme.desc: This documentary covers a pair of World War II battles: the Battle of Peleliu and the Battle of Angaur. It was co-produced by the U.S. Army, U.S. Navy, and the U.S. Marines, and directed by a series of combat cameraman - of whom nine became casualties of the battles they were filming. The film is especially noteworthy for its praise of the fighting abilities of Japanese soldiers.

programme.title: Exploring Hitler's Berlin/Munich
programme.desc: Munich was closely tied to National Socialism, where the Nazi movement, SA, and SS were founded. Hitler called it the 'capital of the movement' and planned grandiose architectural projects. Though most plans weren't realized, landmarks like the 'Haus der Kunst' and parts of the party district still stand today. Rare footage shows Hitler visiting construction sites in Munich's transformed areas.

programme.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Reconnaissance Aircraft
programme.desc: Reconnaissance aircraft play a significant role in both war and peace time. This program looks at several planes that were deployed in this crucial activity including the RA-5C, the Lockheed SR-71 Blackbird, PC3 Orion and the Grumman E-2 Hawkeye.

programme.title: War Machines
programme.desc: Speed and strategy have always defined warfare. This episode explores the evolution of battlefield mobility-from chariots and cavalry to Humvees and tanks. Highlighting the most iconic and influential combat vehicles, including WWII's infamous tanks, we reveal how movement has been a decisive force in shaping tactics, winning battles, and revolutionizing modern war logistics.

programme.title: Animals at War: Wild Heroes of World War II
programme.desc: Fifty million people died in the WWII, the biggest massacre in the history of humanity. But the animal kingdom also paid a heavy toll, despite no official numbers being compiled for the victims. This included combat animals, animals that backed up humans, those that entertained or consoled them, some that fed people, and other animals that were symbols.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: After the bombing of Hiroshima and Nagasaki, Japan surrenders unconditionally to the Allies and reconstruction efforts begin.

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: The Alps Front, June 1940. A handful of French soldiers are about to face a flood of 300,000 Italians. Everywhere in France, you see defeat. The Government fled to Bordeaux on June 14th. While France is breaking down, General Olry and his men remain stationed on the Alps. During ten days of fierce battle, the Italians will lose more than 6,000 men without seizing an inch of French territory.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: An in-depth look at the air war over Japan during WWII, including the Doolittle Raid, B-29 attacks, and the nuclear bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

programme.title: WWII War Diaries
programme.desc: In this final film of the series, '1945', the end of the war is now truly in sight. Yet there were still hurdles to overcome, and with the completion of the Battle of the Bulge still to test the Allies, the race for Berlin was on. Discover what happened in Hitler's final hours and enjoy the VE Day celebrations with Winston Churchill and the people of Britain as the dream of victory became reality.

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: In the early 1480s, Leonardo Da Vinci designed an aerial screw. Its intended use was unknown, yet served as the inspiration for the helicopter. Developments over the years have seen the Helicopter becoming more involved in troop transport, including airlifting the wounded directly to hospitals. Today's attack Helicopters show the versatility of this war machine.

programme.title: The Stuka
programme.desc: From the moment of the Germany invasion of Poland in 1940, to the downfall of the Third Reich in 1945, one plane was synonymous with the terror and destruction caused by the Luftwaffe during WW2. The infamous Yunkers U87, a dive bomber. There were other dive bombers, but only the U87 was known by the British as and feared, named by the abbreviation - The Stuka.

programme.title: Hitler's Favourite Royal
programme.desc: Prince Charles Edward was Queen Victoria's youngest grandchild. Brought up at Claremont House and educated at Eton until he was 14, Charles Edward was forced by Queen Victoria to take up the Dukedom of Coburg in Germany after a series of unexpected deaths of uncles and cousins. Transformed overnight from a British Prince to a German Duke, his life was altered in ways he could never have imagined.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The Gustav and Gothic Lines- Battle for Italy
programme.desc: A look at the Battle of the Gothic Line from an American Soldier and a soldier from the German Wehrmacht. Also features bonus footage of the Battle Of The Bulge.

programme.title: World War II: The Sound and the Fury
programme.desc: Stalingrad breaks the Nazi advance; Japan falters at Guadalcanal. The tide begins to turn. Mussolini falls as Allies land in Sicily. The Soviets crush Germany at Kursk. Allied tech improves-radar, codebreaking, bombing raids. War spreads into the skies. In Tehran, Roosevelt, Churchill, and Stalin prepare for D-Day. The drive to defeat fascism gathers momentum.

programme.title: War Machines
programme.desc: Whether revered or reviled, the invention of the gun forever changed how wars are fought and won. From humble beginnings to a tool that built empires, toppled kingdoms, and killed millions, its story is one of power and evolution. This episode explores the gun's transformation over centuries and its influence on the battlefield, in politics, and in shaping the very course of human history.

programme.title: 3 Days in the Life of Lt. Kravtsov
programme.desc: Lt. Kravtsov, a platoon commander, begins his active duty. The odds are against him, as lieutenants typically have only three days to live. Within this time, he must lead his troops in a futile attack, hoping to save the incoming regiment. Can he survive these three days?

programme.title: Air Power
programme.desc: The 1930's bring remarkable advances in military flight and provide Germany and Japan with decisive advantages in the air as World War II begins. The Germans pound London in the Battle of the Blitz while Japanese naval aviation brings the United States into the war with the attack on Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: He's a meat eater. She's a vegetarian. Their kitchen has become a battleground. Can this marriage be saved? It's Ellie to the rescue with flexible recipes that will bring them together. Recipes include Warm Spinach Salad with grilled sirloin, Panzanella with White Beans with chicken sausage, Forbidden Rice Bowl, and Grilled veggies & lamb kabobs served with Tahini Sauce.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Herbivore VS Carnivore

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Ellie prepares an ensemble of make-ahead dishes that are designed so that both party-giver and partygoers can equally enjoy the festivities. These dishes can be cooked and frozen ahead of time and then reheated at party time. Go ahead: enjoy your own party. Recipes include Asian Shrimp Cakes served with Avocado-Wasabi Sauce, Chicken Phyllo Pies, Broccoli & Sun-Dried Tomato Flatbread, and more.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - It's My Party

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Americans get more than 25% of calories from snacks. Ellie shows how to make them count with some great ways to satisfy the cravings we get around the clock. Recipes include 3-ingredient Chocolate Grape Banana Skewers, Nutty Oatmeal Bars, Spring Cottage Peas with Basil, and Hummus with Cumin-Roasted Carrots.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Snack Attack

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Are you floundering when it comes to adding fish to your menu? Ellie is your fishing guide as she demystifies the choosing, prepping, and cooking of fish. programme.desc: Ex-FBI agent Will Graham (Edward Norton) is an expert investigator who quit the Bureau after almost losing his life in the process of capturing the elusive Dr. Lecter (Anthony Hopkins). After a series of particularly grisly murders, Graham soon realizes that the best way to catch this killer, known as the Tooth Fairy, is to find a way to get inside the killer's mind. For Graham, that means confronting his past and facing his former nemesis, the now-incarcerated Lecter.

programme.title: Eastern Promises
programme.desc: Nikolai (Viggo Mortensen), who is both ruthless and mysterious, has ties to one of the most dangerous crime families in London. He crosses paths with Anna (Naomi Watts), a midwife who has come across potentially damaging evidence against the family, which forces him to set in motion a plan of deceit, death and retribution.

programme.title: A Perfect Getaway
programme.desc: Newlyweds Cliff (Steve Zahn) and Cydney (Milla Jovovich) are celebrating their honeymoon by hiking through a secluded region of Hawaii. Their idyllic trek takes a dark turn when they find a group of frightened hikers who claim that another couple has been brutally murdered. Far from civilization and unsure who to trust, Cydney and Cliff soon get locked into a terrifying battle for survival.

programme.title: The Truth About Charlie
programme.desc: Regina (Thandie Newton) meets charming Joshua (Mark Wahlberg) while vacationing in Martinique, as she contemplates ending her whirlwind marriage to enigmatic Charlie (Stephen Dillane). Then upon her return to Paris, she finds that both her apartment and her bank account have been emptied, and her husband has been murdered. The more Reggie learns, the more she realizes the scope of the puzzle, which she must solve to protect herself from ever-increasing danger.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: Cloak and Dagger
programme.desc: With his mother dead and his father, Hal Osborne (Dabney Coleman), busy working, 11-year-old Davey (Henry Thomas) spends his time immersed in video games, often dreaming up espionage stories featuring imaginary spy Jack Flack (also Coleman). When Davey sees the murder of an FBI agent, the dying man hands him an Atari video game cartridge with military secrets. No one believes his story, and Davey is forced to go on the run, escaping from attempts on his life with Flack's guidance.

programme.title: Weird Science
programme.desc: Teen misfits Gary and Wyatt design their ideal woman on a computer, and a freak electrical accident brings her to life in the form of the lovely, superhuman Lisa. She outfits Gary and Wyatt in cool clothes, surprises them with a Porsche and helps them stand up to jerks Ian and Max. But, all the while, the boys must hide Lisa's existence from Chet, Wyatt's nightmare of a big brother.

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: Conan the Destroyer
programme.desc: In his second cinematic adventure, the mighty warrior Conan (Arnold Schwarzenegger) is tricked into working for the scheming Queen Taramis (Sarah Douglas). Along with finding a mystical horn, Conan and his allies, which include the fierce fighter, Zula (Grace Jones), and the wisecracking sorcerer, Akiro (Mako), must protect the beautiful young Princess Jehnna (Olivia d'Abo). With deception and danger at every turn, Conan has to use all of his power to defeat the evil foes that stand in his way.

programme.title: Kull the Conqueror
programme.desc: After five years as a slave, warrior Kull travels to the shores of the fantastical kingdom of Valusia, where he slays mad King Borna. Inheriting the crown, Kull begins an ambitious program of bringing freedom and tolerance to Valusia, which displeases Gen. Taligaro and the royal court's advisers. Determined to unseat Kull, Taligaro has a wizard resurrect the witch Akivasha to seduce and destroy the new monarch.

programme.desc: Trailing 27-26, the Rams kept their poise to set up a potential game-winning, 44-yard field goal attempt by kicker Joshua Karty. Instead, Karty's kick was blocked for a second time and returned for a touchdown by Jordan Davis to seal the game.

programme.title: NFL Highlights
programme.desc: Best moments and compilations including player highlights, top plays and game highlights from Week 3 of the 2026 NFL season.

programme.title: NFL Daily
programme.desc: Gregg Rosenthal and a rotating crew of elite NFL Media co-hosts get you caught up daily on all the NFL news and analysis ahead of Week 3 during the 2026 NFL season.

programme.title: The NFL Report
programme.desc: The NFL Report is NFL Channel's brand-new live news and information show. Hosted by veteran NFL anchor Andrew Siciliano, the show delivers live reporting, analysis and insight on the biggest stories and latest developments from around the NFL.

programme.title: Power Rankings
programme.desc: Hosts Colleen Wolfe and Nick Shook break down the weekly rankings of all 32 NFL teams, analyzing the biggest risers, fallers and where each team stands following Week 3 of the 2026 NFL season.

programme.title: Secret Shaolin Kung Fu
programme.desc: Han Wei, waits tables at a small establishment and learns the Butterfly Fist from his old, blind grandfather. One day, a mischievous old beggar shows up at the restaurant to solicit wine, and irritate Han Wei. Soon afterward, members of the Beggar Clan start dying off by a group of mysterious fighters. The remaining members of the Beggar Clan begin looking for a new Chief and secrets are disclosed.

programme.title: Ninja in Action
programme.desc: A ninja fighter and his American girlfriend journey to Hong Kong in search of the man who murdered her father.

programme.title: Chivalrous Inn
programme.desc: Patriotic sword fighters are for and against the Ching (Manchu) Dynasty as they head towards the Martial Inn. Three old men with long silver hair (who are very difficult to tell apart!) are key characters, along with a number of young men and very pretty young women, all very capable sword fighters. Buried under the smoldering looks, suspicions and even lines spoken in dialogue poetic couplets, there's even a murder mystery.

programme.title: Young Hero of Shaolin Pt. 2
programme.desc: Fong Sai Yuk just gets back from Siu Lam Ji and has mastered the two finger handstand. He teams up with a friend, who is good at eagle claw boxing and together they take on an evil Taoist Wu Tang priest, who is causing havoc in Southern China.

programme.title: Warriors of Budo
programme.desc: "The only answer to aggression is love and harmony" he would say. The practice of Aikido continues today with his grandson Moriteru Ueshiba who inherited the title of Doshu. At his morning class which begins at dawn, Doshu teaches Irimi-nage, bringing the founders concepts alive. As the attacker moves forward to strike, he is not stopped. Instead Doshu avoids conflict by entering to his side, and in turning to face the same direction they harmonize.
programme.sub-title: Warriors of Budo Episode Three: Aikido

programme.title: Blood of Dragon Peril
programme.desc: The Master of Manchuria's most renowned school of kung-fu is slaughtered when he resists the invading Japanese. His eldest son is beaten so badly he becomes mentally retarded. The second son, Lui, surrenders and joins the army - much to the derision of the villagers. The last son disappears. When a masked man begins appearing and making trouble at the Japanese army bases, Lui is ordered to find and kill him. He almost succeeds, but at the last moment discovers the masked man's secret...

programme.title: Super Ninja
programme.desc: The incredible Alexander Lou teams up with martial arts master Eugene Thomas in this amazing martial arts action extravaganza! Lou is a masterful modern-day Ninja, who must defeat dozens of enemies ranging from killers to corrupt cops! Extremely violent and filled with over the top, Rambo-like explosive action, Super Ninja is super cool kung fu fighting! Wild film!

programme.title: Kung Fu from Beyond the Grave
programme.desc: Rare Billy film! Watch him fight Lo Lieh and demons! On the 7th month of the lunar calendar, all ghosts and spirits are active and get to walk the earth for a month so that they can find a way to reincarnate. During one of these nights, a young kid named Chun Sing (Billy Chong), is visited by his dead Father. Chun Sing's father states that he was murdered by a man named Kam Tai Fu (Lo Lieh). And as you may have guessed, Chun Sing must avenge his father's death.

programme.title: Commando the Ninja
programme.desc: David, an up-coming young master of Ninjitsu, is recruited by his master to steal the formula for a bacteriological weapon and to free the Japanese scientist who is responsible for developing it. He is pitted against two wily opponents: Mark, a KGB operative, and Martin, who are bent on using the formula in a bid for world domination. The fate of humanity is in the hands of David and a group of four surprisingly acrobatic young fighters.

programme.title: Dynamo
programme.desc: Bruce Li is hired by a talent agency to become the next big martial arts star, due to his resemblance to Bruce Lee. However, a rival agency becomes jealous of Bruce's success, and attempts to have him killed. See Bruce Li fight karate legend Steve Sanders!

programme.title: The Invincible
programme.desc: The infamous "Red Dragon" and his Mongolian counterparts invade China and massacre countless people. The situation looks terrible but then a hero emerges who wants to defy the Red Dragon; Li Mu-Bai (Wang Yu), the Invincible!

programme.title: Return of Fist of Fury
programme.desc: Pai Wu Chin (Bruce Pak) is a stranger in town who is on a mission to find out the whereabouts of his missing brother (Bruce Le), who rumor has it, was murdered by the chief inspector of police. Pei Chiu Ting is the brother of the ex-chief inspector and is now the head samurai who wants Pai Wu killed on site. Non-stop action follows when Pai Wu meets Po Zu Pai, who together faces their common enemy and fights the samurai clan.

programme.title: The Iron Man
programme.desc: Chin (Wang Yu), whose family was killed and his left hand cut off by a brutal Japanese general Fang Woo (Lung Fei) during the occupation of China in World War II. After 12 years of training in kung fu, Chin travels to Japan to seek revenge on those who wronged him and his family. Action packed one armed classic!

programme.title: Snuff Bottle Connection
programme.desc: A conspiracy by Chinese traitors to cede large amount of land to the Russians is uncovered by a government agent. After an investigator is killed confronting brawling Russian soldiers, a regional chancellor brings in Shao Ting Shang (John Liu) to figure out what is behind the murder.

programme.title: Eagle Claws Champion
programme.desc: Unruly Eagle's Claw champion Kim goes through a series of tough life challenges after mistakenly killing his opponent, Wu's brother. With Wu on this trail he must get his life together and perfect his technique in order to survive the inevitable showdown against the mighty tiger fists.

programme.title: The Iron Profligate
programme.desc: A detective and self-confessed profligate and martial artists of the highest caliber team up to smash an illegal gambling house and drug smuggling outfit.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Ernie Reyes
programme.desc: This unique documentary reveals the life of pioneer Ernie Reyes. Raised in poverty and prejudice, he was able to persevere. Through decades of vigorous training, he became one of the top nationally rated competitors in both forms and fighting. He is the chief instructor and co-founder of one of the biggest and most successful schools in the world, the West Coast World Martial Arts.

programme.title: The Eagle Fist
programme.desc: A young militia fighter decides to throw in his lot and go off and learns kung fu. He meets a master of the Eagle fist and soon becomes a master, as well as learning some dark truths about his teacher's past and why he was trained to such a high level.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El presidente amenaza a Rivero con desacato o morir en el ejercicio de sus deberes, si no deja en paz a Aurelio.

programme.desc: Doña Alba trata de interceder entre Mónica y Aurelio. Mónica toma una fuerte decisión que afecta a su hijo, Isidrito. Siguiendo sus sospechas, Alba se encuentra con un fantasma del pasado.

programme.title: Paranormal Captured
programme.desc: Unusual activity has been captured on CCTV at an antique centre in Barnsley, UK. It is suspected that a poltergeist may be the culprit. In search of the truth, paranormal investigator Jayne Harris has been despatched to see if she can gather proof for sceptical shop owner Daniel. And in the Paranormal Captured headquarters, footage and stories from around the world are analysed by our experts.

programme.title: Paranormal Captured
programme.desc: The White Swan pub and hotel in Henley in Arden in the UK is reported to be a haunted hotspot. This former jailhouse with gallows has a gruesome history and owners Maria and Nigel believe a lady of the night who died in mysterious circumstances still roams the corridors.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard speaks with victims of alleged electronic harassment, the supposed use of electronic devices to harass, torture, and/or physically harm a person. Some victims allege that the government is behind it. Richard also speaks with a private investigator who specializes in electronic counter measures and a social psychologist who dismisses such claims as fantasy and paranoia.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard travels to southern California to meet several researchers and journalists who present evidence chemicals are being deliberately sprayed at high altitudes for a purpose undisclosed to the general public.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: In 1943 a U.S. navy destroyer escort, the USS Eldridge was allegedly turned invisible and then teleported from the waters of Philadelphia to the Norfolk Naval Station in Virginia. Richard will meet with several researchers and skeptics who have ideas on how such events could have happened.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: The Allies defeated the Axis Powers on the battlefield, but did they actually win the war? Richard travels to Fort Worth Texas and California to interview several alternative historians who affirm their theory that while the German army may have surrendered in 1945, the Nazis never officially did.
programme.sub-title: The Rise of the Fourth Reich: Nazis in America

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: Since the beginning of time man has expressed his religious beliefs through rock art, it gives the feeling that he has worshipped some mysterious gods, that generally came from the stars. Over the millennia, these gods have changed in shape and name, but the way they have been disguised in our beliefs remains the same, in many cases to the misfortune of the witnesses.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: From Mafasca, in the plains of Fuerteventura, to Pardal, in the mountains of Albacete, passing through the light of Cayón in Cantabria, we are talking about intelligent luminosities. These are seen at night and have even followed witnesses. They are the most commonly seen lights, undoubtedly a phenomenon that is part of another of the strangest aspects of the UFO theme: The foo- fighters.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Many experts believe aliens have visited the Earth for thousands of years, but if we can't survive space travel without a protective suit, how can they? Are some aliens mere shells or clones with an artificial consciousness?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: In the spring of 1952, UFO sightings go off the charts. For years, the U.S. government has told the postwar public that UFOs do not exist, but behind the scenes, U.S. Air Force officials are divided.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: In 1969, the U.S. government officially announces it will stop investigating UFOs. However, declassified documents reveal that multiple government agencies have been hiding important UFO sightings for decades.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Since the early 1960s, we've experimented with how to travel off planet Earth. Many experts believe America has operated a secret Space Force for decades, with ultra high-tech ships designed for missions beyond Earth's orbit.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files examines a conspiracy that may be seeking to eradicate 90% of the world's population. It looks at the Georgia Guidestones built by an unknown architect which call for humanity to reduce its population to below 500 million.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files examines whether the United State military has constructed flying saucers. It looks at unclassified documents describing Project 1794 and a supersonic large disk fighter aircraft. These plans are later developed by a Canadian company Avro Aircraft into the Avrocar.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: There are three types of close encounters, sightings, fleeting interactions, aliens taking humans for extended periods. We meet real people who have experienced alien life up close.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: From military radar to Navy aircraft, sightings of Unidentified Aerial Phenomena have become more frequent of late and been measured on ever more sophisticated technology. It has lead to unprecedented acceptance of alien contact across the globe, including by the US government. What could these visitors be after? Is it the potential energy stored in the Earth's oceans?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Several US presidents throughout history have described encounters with UAPs. Is there already an agreement in place between our world leaders and intelligent alien life? And if so, who is keeping that information from the public and why?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: In 1998 Astronauts captured images of a satellite in Earth's orbit. Is it the same alien object that Nicola Tesla detected in 1899, an alien probe known as the Black Knight? And in 2017 scientists discovered another mysterious satellite from outside our solar system. What could explain Oumuamua's artificial trajectory?

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: Much of inland California is remote wilderness. Within the Sierra Mountains, come legends of the Bigfoot Wars... and a terrifying Evil Gnome that stalks an innocent family. Further south, the legendary HellHound wreaks havoc in a desert neighborhood.
programme.sub-title: Bigfoot Wars, Evil Gnome, Hell Hound

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: Out of the Badlands, a wasteland so desolate that nothing is known to take root, come three terrifying stories: the 'Devil's Highway', menacing Black Eyed Kids, and the Curse of Superstition Mountain.

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: In a small Vermont town, the legendary Pigman unleashes a beastly wrath upon trespassing teenagers; an alluring hitchhiker has monstrous plans for anyone who gives her a ride; and the classified details of a secret government program using psychic spies.
programme.sub-title: Vermont Pigman, The Bridge Where I Died, and Project Stargate

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: When desert ranchers suffer unexplained terror, the suspects appear to be Thunderbirds and Skinwalkers. A family comes under attack by the Nightstalker, and a couple reveals their horrifying encounter with extraterrestrials-Alien Abductions.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: There are three types of close encounters, sightings, fleeting interactions, aliens taking humans for extended periods. We meet real people who have experienced alien life up close.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: As the Fermi Paradox states, the possibilities that there is advanced life in the universe is surprisingly high. And if the universe is so old, why haven't we had any contact with extraterrestrial life?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: In 1998 Astronauts captured images of a satellite in Earth's orbit. Is it the same alien object that Nicola Tesla detected in 1899, an alien probe known as the Black Knight? And in 2017 scientists discovered another mysterious satellite from outside our solar system. What could explain Oumuamua's artificial trajectory?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Mars is the key focus of humanity's expansion into space right now. Millions of years ago the Red Planet had a lot in common with Earth, but it's now a desert wasteland. Do the doorways recently discovered on the planet's surface lead to an existential lesson for our species?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: In July of 2023, David Grusch, a former high ranking US Intelligence officer testified to a US government Oversight Committee that there are alien spacecraft located at secret facilities in the US.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Is Britain facing an alien invasion? Does it know more than it's saying? And is it really dedicated to protecting its citizens? Or is it only protecting itself. From military cover-ups, to dire warnings from government insiders we unseal the explosive secrets of the real British X-Files.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: All around the world, millions of people from all walks of life are reporting the same thing. Aliens have arrived on Earth. Is this the biggest, most well organized hoax in history? Can millions of witnesses worldwide be wrong? In fact many experts believe, all signs point to a massive global cover-up. We unseal the truth behind the most active alien hotspots on Earth.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: An extraterrestrial threat. A top secret organization. Has the US made contact with aliens? Experts believe they have. And an ultra top secret organization is calling all the shots. Get ready for the untold story of Majestic 12.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: More than half the world's UFO sightings happen over water. Many of these phenomena are seen bursting from the ocean into the sky. Do aliens lurk in our oceans? Join us as we expose the growing threat of Unidentified Submerged Objects.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: What does the American government really know about UFO's? And how far will they go to hide the truth? In 1948 a fireball crashes near Laredo, Texas. They say it was an experimental aircraft. But many experts believe it was a UFO.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: The Soviet Union's vast skies paid witness to thousands of UFO sightings. But the Soviet regime was notorious for secrecy. Many of their encounters reported during the Cold War had potentially deadly consequences for the entire world.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Bex and Sean explore Gwrych Castle in Wales, renowned for its hauntings. Amid eerie voices, strange noises, and shadows, they use specialized equipment to unveil the spectral mysteries lurking within. Will they unearth Gwrych Castle's ghostly secrets?

programme.title: The Past Hunters: Enter the Paranormal
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Hoylake and investigate a building known as The Parade. Dating back to 1909, this once former school, still seems to have ghostly pupils and teachers taking classes.

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: This episode explores the paranormal mysteries surrounding an August 2000 Briton sighting, where police crossed paths with a strange light in the sky.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Sean, Bex, and Paul return to The Vale Bar as paranormal activity escalates. Strange voices, eerie movements, and ghostly warnings hint at multiple entities. With spirits growing bolder and unsettling responses intensifying, the team delves deeper into the bar's mysterious past. Are they uncovering secrets or provoking something more sinister?

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: On December 28, 1980, the Rendlesham Incident became a legendary mystery, as US Air Force soldiers recorded witness accounts of mysterious lights appearing in the skies of Suffolk, England.

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: Three English UFO searchers from Netley, Southampton are profiled in this episode.

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: Chris Martin is a British man who has spent his life collecting footage of suspected alien sightings. Martin shares his insights on UFO phenomena in this episode.

programme.title: Paranormal Captured
programme.desc: Katy from Mold, in Wales is convinced that her Party Shop is haunted be previous tenants of the 17th Century building. Paranormal investigator Lee Roberts has been enlisted to see if he can capture proof and back up claims that a ghost called Sarah, a young servant girl, is still residing in the premises.

programme.title: Paranormal Captured
programme.desc: Labyrinth Lodge in Liverpool in the UK is a haunted house in a cemetery. Originally it was a register office, recording births, deaths and marriages. But it seems some previous residents just don't want to leave. Paranormal investigator Jayne Harris is on hand to capture proof for current owners Sean and Bex, who are hoping to understand more about the strange goings on in their home.

programme.title: War On Witches
programme.desc: In the late 16th century Europe was in the grip of a witch hunt fever. Thousands were tortured and burnt at the stake. The church was fully behind this terrifying crusade. In France and Germany alone up to 40,000 people may have been killed as witches. England and Scotland were almost untouched by witch persecutions until King James himself decided to launch his own, personal war on witchcraft.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard delves into the religious practice known as exorcism and investigates what a board certified psychiatrist has described as 'an authentic case of demonic possession.'

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: The Allies defeated the Axis Powers on the battlefield, but did they actually win the war? Richard travels to Fort Worth Texas and California to interview several alternative historians who affirm their theory that while the German army may have surrendered in 1945, the Nazis never officially did.
programme.sub-title: The Rise of the Fourth Reich: Nazis in America

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard interviews two whistleblowers who claim to have been part of secret government time travel projects, including a lawyer who insists as a child he was sent back in time to witness Lincoln's Gettysburg Address. An experimental physicist provides a skeptical perspective.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard meets the owners of an abnormal humanoid skull allegedly discovered in Mexico in the 1930s and speaks with the researcher who conducted tests on the skull. Is it the skull of a badly deformed child? Is it a hoax? Is it the remains of an extraterrestrial? Is it a human-alien hybrid? A cranio-facial surgeon and a skeptic provide us with their perspectives on this very strange relic.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Global Warming, A Hoax? Richard speaks with several journalists and researchers who argue the theory that human use of carbon-based fossil fuels will lead to catastrophic climate change.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: What can lead a military man to draw his service weapon in his own base, and completely unload the magazine of his rifle? In the cases that we are going to analyze, these military men claim to have witnessed the appearance of strange humanoid beings.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: Explore mysterious sightings spanning millennia, from ancient rock art to recent encounters. Witness strange lights over Barranco de Badajoz and a peculiar being at 'El Condesito' farm in Huelva. Encounter enigmatic humanoids on Conil beaches. Hear from witnesses to unravel the uncanny connection between past depictions and present sightings.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Since the Jet Age, fighter pilots have been scrambled to intercept UFOs in our skies, but what happens when pilots are sent a Shoot Down Order and can't complete their mission?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: For decades, governments around the world have investigated UFO sightings, often times under an umbrella of secrecy. How are these top-secret studies conducted? Who is called upon to analyze the evidence?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: If aliens have visited Earth, why are they here and what are they truly after? Investigations have revealed the possibility that aliens are interested in experimenting on not only the human body, but the human mind as well.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: The end is near. There have been signs and prophecies for centuries but it does feel like man's time on this planet is almost over. The question is: are you ready for Doomsday?

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: There is a secret government facility accused of creating many diseases currently plaguing our country. Have we unleashed these biological weapons on purpose and if so, is there a secret lab near you?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Mars is the key focus of humanity's expansion into space right now. Millions of years ago the Red Planet had a lot in common with Earth, but it's now a desert wasteland. Do the doorways recently discovered on the planet's surface lead to an existential lesson for our species?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: According to physics, time travel is possible. So could it be that UAPs aren't coming from somewhere else, but from some when else. Could these UAPs be us, from the future?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Certain structures on our planet have stood the test of time and continue to astonish mankind. So much so, that alien intervention in their construction thousands of years ago, has yet to be ruled out.
